proposal.rationale: Ontology r_relax_hough: lower the oblique Hough threshold and raise oblique maxLineGap so intersections replace the horizontal fallback, after ruling out a collapsed depth map. The closest worked analogy is complex-correspondencef1at15-improve-s021 (same family, 10 rings, correspondence-led, ring_count_error=0), whose detecting block was binary_threshold=127, hough_threshold_oblique=27, hough_threshold_horizontal=60, maxLineGap_oblique=74, maxLineGap_horizontal=28, pattern_tolerance=11 and, jointly, lifted correspondence 0.446→0.460 without losing rings. That reference had stage-1 unlocked, so unfolding is omitted here. The degrade analogy (oblique threshold 63, horizontal threshold 25, maxLineGap_oblique 37, plus a near-zero radial window) collapsed correspondence and fill; the fill-seeking analogy raised sam_fill_rate only 0.752→0.759 while correspondence fell 0.446→0.365, so SAM and denoising are left unchanged. Vertical Hough is left unchanged because the ten ring lines are already correct.
